setupTransactions.name: createFakeUsdcMint
setupTransactions.description: Create a deterministic fake USDC SPL mint controlled by the payer.

setupTransactions.name: initializeExchange
setupTransactions.description: Initialize Ember and Phoenix global exchange state using fake USDC as the Ember input mint.

setupTransactions.name: initializeMarkets
setupTransactions.description: Create and activate BTC, ETH, and SOL perpetual markets.

setupTransactions.description: Create oracle delegation for the price oracle and set deterministic mark/spot prices.

setupTransactions.name: seedSplineTraderCollateral

setupTransactions.name: orderbookPlaceLevels

actionTemplates.name: oracleSetPrices

actionTemplates.name: orderbookPlaceLevels
